paite: Pathian limsakloute hoihsak bang a om ngei lou a, mikhialte lampi a leng dingh lou a, musitte tutphah a leng tu ngeiloumi ahampha hi.
heading: BU KHATNA / (Sam 1-41) / Kipahna Dik
english: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

paite: Akipahna tuh TOUPA dan ah ahi zaw a; adan thu sun leh zan in angaihtuah ngitnget hi.
english: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

paite: Amah zaw tui luang kiang a sing suan ahun a gah zel, anah leng kau ngei lou bang ahi a; athilhih peuhmah alamzang zel ding hi.
english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

paite: Pathian limsakloute huchibang ahi kei ua; buhsi huih in amut lengmang bang ahi zaw uhi.
english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

paite: Huaiziak in mi Pathian limsakloute zaw vaihawmna ma ah adingh thei kei ding uh, mikhialte leng midiktatte omkhopna ah adingh thei sam kei ding uhi.
english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

paite: TOUPA'N midiktatte lampi athei naknak ngal a; mikhialte lampi bel amangthang ding hi.
english: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
